stem: Which statement about the structure of an atom is correct?

options.A: Protons, neutrons and electrons are packed evenly throughout the atom.
options.B: The nucleus contains protons and electrons and takes up most of the volume of the atom.
options.C: Protons and neutrons are in a small, dense nucleus and the electrons are in shells in the space around it.
options.D: The nucleus contains only protons, and the neutrons and electrons are in shells around it.

stem: Which particles are found in the nucleus of an atom?
Which statement compares the size of the nucleus with the size of the whole atom?

options.A: The nucleus is about half the diameter of the atom.
options.B: The nucleus is about the same size as the atom.
options.C: The nucleus is very much smaller than the atom, and most of the atom is empty space.
options.D: The nucleus is larger than the atom because it contains the protons and neutrons.

stem: Which row gives the relative charge and the relative mass of a neutron?
Which statement about protons, neutrons and electrons is correct?

options.A: A neutron and an electron have the same mass and neither is charged.
options.B: A proton and an electron have the same mass but opposite charges.
options.C: A proton and a neutron have almost the same mass, and only the proton is charged.
options.D: An electron is heavier than a neutron and has the opposite charge to a proton.

options.D: the number of electrons in an ion of the element

stem: Which statement describes the distribution of mass and charge in an atom?

options.A: The mass is spread evenly through the atom and the positive charge is in the nucleus.
options.B: The mass is in the nucleus and the positive charge is in the electron shells.
options.C: Nearly all of the mass and all of the positive charge are in the nucleus.
options.D: Nearly all of the mass is in the electron shells and the positive charge is in the nucleus.

stem: A hydrogen-1 atom has a nucleus of one proton (relative mass 1) and one electron (relative mass $\frac{1}{1836}$). Calculate the percentage of the mass of the atom that is in the nucleus. Give your answer to 4 significant figures.
Why does an atom have no overall electric charge?

options.A: The neutrons cancel out the charge of the protons.
options.B: It contains equal numbers of protons and neutrons.
options.C: It contains equal numbers of protons and electrons.
options.D: Protons and electrons have the same relative mass.

stem: The nucleus of an atom of element Y has a relative charge of +9 and contains 10 neutrons. Which row is correct for the atom?
Beams of protons, neutrons and electrons, all travelling at the same velocity, pass between a positive plate and a negative plate. Which row describes their behaviour?

options.A: Protons are deflected towards the negative plate, neutrons are not deflected, and electrons are deflected towards the positive plate by a smaller angle than protons.
options.B: Protons are deflected towards the negative plate, neutrons are not deflected, and electrons are deflected towards the positive plate by a larger angle than protons.
options.C: Protons are deflected towards the positive plate, neutrons are not deflected, and electrons are deflected towards the negative plate.
options.D: Protons and electrons are deflected through the same angle in opposite directions, and neutrons are not deflected.
